prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply finops expertise to this task". The evidence packet contains conflicting stakeholder pressure, incomplete evidence, capacity or cost constraints, and an attractive option whose reversibility and opportunity cost differ from alternatives. The acceptance boundary is finops-cloud-cost: Allocate spend to products/teams/environments and normalize by useful business or workload units before optimization. The adjacent aws-cloud discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: FOCUS-style billing exports with billed/effective/list/contracted costs and invoice control totals
direct/shared/unallocated allocation metadata plus product transaction denominators
usage/performance/reliability evidence and overlapping provider optimization recommendations
before/after implementation cost and guardrail fixtures
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual finops-cloud-cost boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=operational-data-analysis; near-neighbor=aws-cloud), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Allocate spend to products/teams/environments and normalize by useful business or workload units before optimization.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Reconcile billing exports to provider totals, compare unit cost over time, model commitment utilization/risk, validate savings after changes, and monitor performance/reliability guardrails.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not cut cost by deleting resilience blindly, buy commitments before workload stability, compare raw monthly totals across growth periods, or count list-price discounts as realized savings without usage.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Billing/export/schema/currency/cost-lens reconciliation to provider or invoice totals; Allocation/shared-cost/unallocated coverage plus business/resource unit-economics definitions and driver decomposition; Usage/rightsize/rate/commitment scenarios using effective costs, coverage/utilization, overlapping recommendation and risk evidence; Implemented before/after realized savings, reliability/performance guardrails, owner/governance and rollback/action ledger), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
